text.tspan: Children who experience violent discipline, boys vs. girls 2014
Percentage of boys and girls, 2–14 years old, who according to self-reports by caregivers experienced violent
discipline at home in the past month.

tspan.tspan: Where data for 2014 is unavailable, the value from the closest year between 2005 and 2013 is shown instead.
